about_the_game:
SYNOPSIS:

Cane, once a feared hitman, has no choice but to return to killing alongside his old crew: Jim and Adam. But as the days pass, strange visions and nightmares begin to tear at his sanity.

BLOODVILLE is a retro-inspired first-person shooter with a sharp edge: fast gunplay, bone-crunching melee, and a story that shifts from hired hits to psychological torment. Over seven nights, you’ll unlock weapons, fight through diverse locations, and slowly uncover the reason nothing feels real anymore.

FEATURES:

  • Fast, Fluid Combat - A blend of DOOM’s raw shooter pace and Hotline Miami’s precision brutality.

  • Haunting Atmosphere - Experience tense dream fragments, moody environments and buried memories.

  • Steam Leaderboards - Compete for the most kills, least time and biggest score.
